name: unresolved_vs_resolved
description: Binary ASNE contrast for an open issue versus the same issue being clarified or handled.

problem_unresolved.text: A person refreshes the form and still sees a blank space where the confirmation number should be.
Someone checks the hallway and sees the broken panel still hanging beside the elevator.
A person opens the storage drawer and sees no cable for the projector.
Someone reads the updated message and still sees no room listed for the meeting.
A person searches the desk again and sees no signed form under the folders.

problem_resolved.text: A person refreshes the form and sees the confirmation number appear in the blank space.
Someone checks the hallway and sees a technician replacing the broken panel beside the elevator.
A person opens the storage drawer and sees the cable for the projector.
Someone reads the updated message and sees a room listed for the meeting.
A person searches the desk again and sees the signed form under the folders.
